_: THE LIGHTLESS — deeps_1. Re-run with: tools/shot.sh --seq=tools/seq/deeps_1.json
One capture per screen — A twice, B three times, D three times, C twice — and every
__: one of them is a teaching beat: the daylight, the threshold it fails at, the
___: lightless gallery, the marked hole, the wall that glows and will not open, the
____: drop, both spore pits, the pad at the bottom of the brood shaft, and the lit exit.

_: CAPTURED BRIGHT, ON PURPOSE. This level has no data/ambience.json entry yet —
__: that entry is printed by tools/worlds/deeps_1.py and belongs to the integration
___: pass — so every shot below is the geometry with the lights off. What the dark
____: will look like is a separate one-off:
______: Ambience.darkness_override is read straight off the command line, so that capture
_______: shows the 74 px lantern and NOTHING else — no pools, no emissive tiles — which is
________: the worst case the eight authored pools and the twenty-one glowing tiles exist to fix.

_: GOTCHAS. A teleport puts the TOP-LEFT of the body on the tile's top-left, so a
__: 22 px human's feet land 6 px into the row below: aim one row ABOVE the row she
___: should stand on and let her drop. Teleporting onto the exit tile completes the
____: level and the capture lands on the hub, so the last shot stands six tiles short
_____: of it. And a bare {"settle": n} step is a NO-OP — dev_capture.gd only reads
______: `settle` off a `scenario` or a `teleport`; idling on its own is {"wait": n}.

_: SCREEN A — THE MOUTH. Spawn at (6,12) directly under the sinkhole: three columns
__: of open shaft from row 1 down to the floor she is standing on, twelve tiles of it.
___: The floor is flat, the room is seven tiles tall, and nothing is in it.
____: settle 210, not 90: the level-title card is still up at 90 and covers the room.

_: SCREEN A — THE THRESHOLD, mark 'threshold' at (15,12). The roof steps from row 5
__: to row 8 here and the daylight stops with it. In the dark this is the last of the
___: authored pools (0.22) and everything east of it is hers to carry.

_: SCREEN B — THE LIGHTLESS, mark 'dark_gallery' at (30,12). Thirty-one columns of
__: flat floor under four tiles of headroom, chewed open into niches at cols 20-22,
___: 27-29 and 34-36. No gap, no hazard, nothing patrolling: this is the safe room.
____: The deep_fungus at (30,9) over the gem is the first time a pool of light in this

_: SCREEN B — THE MARKED HOLE, mark 'shaft_head' at (39,12). The floor's cap stops
__: at col 39; cols 40-41 are the descent. Signed twice: fungus at (39,9) and (42,9)
___: flank the mouth on the roof, and the deep_ladder at col 40 runs the whole way
____: down for anyone who would rather climb than drop.

_: SCREEN B — THE WALL THAT GLOWS. Standing at (43,12), two tiles past the hole,
__: looking at the level's ONE breakable tile: luminous_wall (214) from floor to roof
___: at col 44, with a heart behind it. Off every hop, and unprovable by construction —
____: tools/solver/sim.gd breaks nothing. deeps_2 CHEW THROUGH is where it becomes a verb.

_: SCREEN D — THE FOOT OF THE SHAFT, at (41,26), one tile east of mark 'shaft_foot'.
__: Fourteen tiles down onto unbroken floor with no hazard under it: getting the dark
___: wrong still costs nothing here. The dead-end crawl at cols 42-46 is in shot, and
____: so is the whole spore walk running away west.

_: SCREEN D — SPORE PIT 1, seen from its east lip at (37,26). Two tiles wide, one row
__: of deep_spore at row 27 over solid fill: fall in, take the hit, climb one tile out.
___: In the dark the pit is the brightest thing on the screen — `emissive` puts a pool
____: on tile 267 — because a dark hazard you cannot see is not a lesson, it is a coin toss.

_: SCREEN D — SPORE PIT 2 and the one thing that patrols down here. Standing at
__: (31,26) on its east lip: two tiles wide and TWO rows deep, so leaving it costs the
___: human her whole measured 2-tile rise. The walker spawns at (33,26) and turn_at_ledge
____: pins it to cols 31-34, between the two pits — which is what makes this jump an ask
_____: rather than a repeat of the last one.

_: SCREEN C — THE BROOD SHAFT. Teleported a row high so she falls INTO pad_frog's box
__: (the lower half of its tile) at (19,26) rather than being placed past it. Every
___: capture from here on is the frog. Twelve tiles of chamber above her and three
____: treads of deep_shelf climbing west in 3-tile steps: the frog's measured ceiling,
_____: and one more than the human's, so the pad is load-bearing rather than decoration.

_: SCREEN C — THE LIT DOORWAY. On tread 3 at (8,17), six tiles short of the exit —
__: standing ON it would end the level and land the capture on the hub. The whole
___: climb is in frame: the fungus at (14,24) and (9,21) marking each tread's west lip,
____: the three rungs of fungus up the west wall, and the exit on its rock shelf under
_____: the one warm pool in the screen. The last thing the level teaches is the thing it
______: has been teaching all along: in the dark you walk towards the light that is not yours.
